remaining_gates.concrete_risk: Current open_audio queues restore before Start. Simply adding Start hooks invalidates that unproved basis; suppressing the hook or inferring proof from equal controls is incorrect. A28 verifies the required new post-Start intention, but main has no LibraryModel hooks. All ordinary/direct-MIDI/recovery/disabled paths need actual exactly-once integration.

controls_pending=false also describes unproved startup. Freeze and admit a model-owned availability/proof projection before browser enablement; do not duplicate private guards or probe request_save_new during paint.
